answer: The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the marble of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The echo holds work receipts rather than names, so the lantern of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
